{{Quote|What is a Wookiee doing helping the Trandoshans?"<br />"I have come to an understanding that my brethren have yet to reach. Battling the Trandoshan and their Imperial backers is futile. The Trandoshans pay me well to help them out with local affairs and that is all you need to know.|A spacer and Orooroo|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
'''Orooroo the Betrayer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Cerca [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Orooroo betrayed his fellow Wookiees, and offered his services to the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]].
